name: Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore
story: Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore is located in the northwestern Lower Peninsula of Michigan, within Benzie and Leelanau counties. The park preserves 71,199 acres along a 35-mile stretch of Lake Michigan's eastern coastline. It is known for its dune formations, forests, beaches, and ancient glacial phenomena.
matters: The landscape was formed approximately 10,000 to 14,000 years ago during the Wisconsin glaciation. A section of the park was named the Sleeping Bear Dunes Wilderness by the United States Congress.
